verdict.rationale: Productboard's docs show feedback/notes can be linked to features, components and other product hierarchy entities through dedicated relationship endpoints (create, list, delete), and that insights in feedback can be linked to feature ideas to quantify demand. Initiatives and releases are reachable only indirectly: features can be added to initiatives and initiatives moved to releases, but nothing shows feedback being linked to them directly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of linking feedback directly to initiatives and releases, UI-level documentation of the linking workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
